identity.basis: Candidate fan symbol belongs to Banco Inter S.A. (BR, bancointer.com.br/inter.co): the Commons 2023 lockup combines the fan with the 'inter' wordmark, and the official Play listing (developer CNPJ confirmed) shows the fan alone as the current app icon.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official currency evidence (Play listing page and its icon raster, SEC filing) is independent of the third-party vector host (Wikimedia Commons upload); the two support identity/currency and geometry provenance respectively.
uncertainties: No official-host standalone SVG obtained: bancointer.com.br and inter.co fetches timed out (failure receipts preserved); vector provenance rests on the Commons copy of the 2023 logo.

variant.basis: Standalone fan symbol variant, matching the current store icon (white symbol on orange field). The accepted base icon is the wordmark avatar variant, not the current standalone-symbol presentation.

proposals.reason: Current official presentation (Google Play listing of Banco Inter S.A., CNPJ confirmed on page) is an orange square with the white 7-bar fan symbol and no wordmark; the accepted base icon is an orange gradient circle with the white 'inter' wordmark, i.e. the older/wordmark avatar variant. A genuine original vector containing the current fan exists (Wikimedia Commons 'Logo do banco Inter (2023).svg', 2023-12 rebrand); the fan is formed by subpaths of the single path element, so a standalone-symbol candidate can be derived without tracing.
